summary: Show a native save dialog and return Electron's cancellation/path result.

target.notes: Requires native platform dialog services; no Chromium dependency is inherently required.

caveats: Electron's asynchronous showSaveDialog uses an empty string filePath when cancelled; do not rewrite this to null/undefined.
With securityScopedBookmarks on macOS MAS, selecting a nonexistent path may create a blank file.

tests.name: choose save path
tests.expected_behavior: returns canceled=false and a chosen filePath

tests.name: cancel save
tests.expected_behavior: returns canceled=true and filePath='' when the user cancels
